stage: 2 necessity, terminology and word choice only
coverage_note: Full eight-unit current path and their sidecars/blocks, plus all Part contribution maps. Current source text was read in this separate stage, with unchanged current bibliography entries also present from the immediately preceding focused call. Earlier teaching was checked before treating terms as missing. Pure markup comments are not reader prose; block titles/captions/alt text were included.

passage_judgments.phrase: how groups of nerve cells represent information
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Establishes the scientific subject, animal/model settings and common behavior question before specialized models.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Nerve cells and concrete tasks precede computational/systems neuroscience; the neuron definition supplies meaning in place.

passage_judgments.phrase: a continuous family of persistent activity patterns
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to distinguish retaining activity from retaining the original angle and to explain what the lower bound concerns.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The following each representing a different value supplies the specialist meaning without asking readers to know attractor geometry at orientation.

passage_judgments.phrase: common source before the final motor neurons
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to interpret the 82 percent estimate and prevent a wrong inference that the study directly recorded integrator noise.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The anatomical relation is given in plain words; shared-drive inference is a route label, not a substitute for the explanation.

passage_judgments.phrase: inactive holes surrounded by activity
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to introduce what field shape adds beyond field sizes and why wiring is a separate claim.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Uses an observable description before the later Euler-characteristic term. Threshold is used with activity above the threshold, supplying its role.

passage_judgments.phrase: connection weights from changing neural states
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to mark the extension and orient a reader entering these Parts separately.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Concrete stored versus changing objects are used before implementation details. Repetition of the no-full-rerun limit is useful across separate entry routes.

passage_judgments.phrase: The Glossary gives short definitions for lookup
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to distinguish lookup from the main explanations and offer full versus paper-specific paths.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The route instructions identify exact earlier sections and do not pretend that a glossary mention teaches an entire method.

passage_judgments.phrase: An equation that specifies how a cell responds belongs to the model
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed because mathematical derivation and biological mechanism answer different questions in this book.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Model, derivation and interpretation receive concrete roles. Appendix section names retain exact technical names because readers must locate them in the original.

passage_judgments.phrase: Derived prediction / Simulation comparison / Empirical comparison
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to compare how each paper obtains support and what remains unknown.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The three kinds of evidence are separated by specific actions and measured objects; replacing every occurrence by result would lose this distinction.

passage_judgments.phrase: published versions / supporting information
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed for direct inspection of figures, original equations and the official correction.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Publication titles, author spellings and section names are source identifiers; paraphrasing them would harm lookup.

passage_judgments.phrase: spatial map, the changing represented position, and the movement measured downstream
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to establish which three objects can be connected and which cannot be identified as one.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Each object is described before its symbol is reused. Model-table labels summarize those already introduced objects.

passage_judgments.phrase: fixed expected-rate function f_i(x)
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to construct the proposed connection between a fixed spatial map and time-varying rates.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Expected rate, coordinate and common displacement are explicit; the conditions on small displacement and extra noise should not be shortened away.

passage_judgments.phrase: It does not establish an inhibitory connection
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed because a negative covariance can otherwise be mistaken for a direct inhibitory edge.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The example and figure text use the same slopes, units and chosen baseline. Repeating the covariance consequence in caption supports inspection without surrounding prose.

passage_judgments.phrase: firing-rate multiplier / instantaneous information rate
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to state what a joint experiment must measure beyond matching a distribution or 1/N scaling.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Multiplier is explained through separate fitting; information rate refers to earlier full teaching in 03-memory-information. Keeping it distinct from generic accuracy preserves the bound conditions.

passage_judgments.phrase: path integration / dendrite
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to identify which earlier studies add dynamic, anatomical, learning or sensory evidence.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Path integration is defined as updating an estimate from movement; dendrites as branching input structures. These terms identify the mechanism and are not decorative vocabulary.

passage_judgments.phrase: same population / physical or neural filters
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to turn the model comparison into a testable proposal with the right measurements.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The list says what to estimate and compare. The final static-fit versus diffusion-fit limits answer the earlier separate-objects question rather than repeat an unrelated caution.

passage_judgments.phrase: The computer stores each neuron's synaptic activation
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to show what gets updated and how generated spikes change later rates.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The recap is brief and anchored to earlier full teaching; deleting it would leave numerical settings without their state variables. Euler update is explained beside its first use here.

passage_judgments.phrase: a numerical proxy for the represented position
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to distinguish the maximum-rate measurement from both relaxation-defined coordinate and ideal spike readout.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The proxy is concretely specified by the immediately preceding largest-rate rule. A generic estimate alone could blur it with the separate optimal-estimator problem.

passage_judgments.phrase: These settings describe the finite simulation
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to avoid adding the large-network 1/N scaling to the wrong weights and to keep correction scope visible.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Units, neuron/trial counts, one-event probability and source inconsistency labels are practical reproduction information; folding them avoids burdening the main mechanism.

passage_judgments.phrase: Converting between activation and rate changes the units
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to prevent wrong comparison of D numbers and copying a single-spike update into aggregate population simulation.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The actual conversion is supplied, not merely a warning. The pair/population distinction gives meaning to aggregate in context; no new formal term is required.

passage_judgments.phrase: A plotted analytical curve is different from a network simulation
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to state what Figures3/S2 actually establish and why unavailable code differs from proven nonexistence.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Analytical is necessary to identify formula-derived curves. The final behavior sentence bridges directly to the eye pathway and has a different role from the code-search limit.

passage_judgments.phrase: fit all trials except one
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to explain the empirical calibration and distinguish single-cell data from simultaneous population data.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Leave-one-out receives its full operation before its label; no specialist statistical method is assumed from the label alone.

passage_judgments.phrase: current internal-command term acts immediately
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to preserve the real causal timing while mapping command, motor spikes, mechanics and feedback.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The repaired wording names both input signals and what is delayed. Each stage has a concrete actor, input and changed quantity.

passage_judgments.phrase: retains every Mth event / random seed
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to explain why lower spike variability and repeatability are separate choices.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Thinning is described as an operation rather than relying on its specialist label. Random seed is defined through generator state and implementation/call-order condition.

passage_judgments.phrase: Published parameters and public-code settings have different sources
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to prevent combining incompatible defaults, interpreting neuron count ambiguously or treating output-noise removal as a deterministic model.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The publication/code distinction makes this repeated caution useful: each statement names its specific N, time step, regression or noise source.

passage_judgments.phrase: Run_model.m / Full_model_simulation.m / Fit_OI_circuit.m
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to connect reproduction tasks to released files and differentiate raw-data reanalysis from loading processed MSD.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Literal filenames are correctly formatted and each has its job. Constrained least squares is listed as a software dependency, not used as an unexplained premise for a new proof.

passage_judgments.phrase: Position is the independent variable
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to prevent taking a generated spatial map as a memory trajectory.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: The generation cycle defines Gaussian filtering, explains shared inputs and gives RMS normalization operationally; these exact operations are needed for code/source comparison.

passage_judgments.phrase: fitted statistic
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to distinguish parameter selection from further model tests.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Defined immediately as a measured summary used to choose parameters. Lognormal and likelihood have actual earlier teaching in 05c-place-tests:173,177; they are not new undefined names here.

passage_judgments.phrase: field edges / correlation scale / filter width
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed because boundaries, cutoffs and scale conventions change the comparison.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Betti numbers and Euler characteristic identify taught measurements, while finite differences refer back to 05b-place-sizes:284. The two widths are explicitly given different symbols and a conversion.

passage_judgments.phrase: A spiking-neuron simulator is not required
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed for choosing the correct kind of computation and checking access to every target map.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: This is a scoped method statement, not a broad claim about every hippocampal model. Program/library names each receive their specific operation.

passage_judgments.phrase: authors' program / independent implementation / smaller teaching model
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed because the three routes support different conclusions.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Concrete actions and outputs define the alternatives. The no-rerun statement refers to the guide and should stay separate from what the sources provided.

passage_judgments.phrase: Optional reconstruction tool
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to distinguish author-used packages from suggestions and deterministic ODE solvers from event-driven stochastic models.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Each literal API has its operation beside it. Replacing solve_ivp, ndimage.label or Brian2 with generic software would remove useful lookup information.

passage_judgments.phrase: discretization / convergence check
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to say how to refine resolution without changing physical noise strength or spatial correlation scale.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Both terms receive operational definitions. The example distinguishes variance from standard deviation and update sampling from output sampling; deleting these qualifications would change the taught check.

passage_judgments.phrase: unit of repetition
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to connect uncertainty to independent repeats and diagnose final-plot disagreement.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Monte Carlo is defined beside its use, and the overlap examples make independence concrete. The record list names choices that affect the scientific conclusion, rather than generic project paperwork.

passage_judgments.phrase: instantaneous attractor state / Poisson process / translation symmetry
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed for lookup after main explanations, particularly where closely related terms differ.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Short definitions suit lookup and need no invented motivating scenario. Poisson includes recurrent conditional-spiking caveat; two translation meanings stay separate; Cramer Rao keeps regularity/local conditions.

passage_judgments.phrase: SRAM / PCM / random seed / fitted statistic
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to find exact technical names from the chapters.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Exact hardware acronyms remain tied to physical storage meanings and links. Simulation definitions remain short because the earlier chapter explains the full method; expanding each into a lesson would duplicate that teaching.

passage_judgments.phrase: Associated paper
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed for stable source lookup and distinguishing paper, code, dataset and documentation.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Publication titles and API names must remain exact even when longer than ordinary prose. Associated paper is a short direct role and its DOI avoids a fragile numeric pointer. No scientific argument should be added to each entry.

passage_judgments.location: all Part openings and chapter contribution maps
passage_judgments.phrase: Central / Supporting / Background / Guide-derived
passage_judgments.deletion_test: Needed to explain what each chapter contributes and how different evidence types relate.
passage_judgments.word_choice_reason: Repeated label key is justified for readers entering individual Part pages. Author-year names and roles are concrete; no new compound label or abstract umbrella replaces the described result.

findings.phrase: Its output lies on the finite lattice of preferred angles
findings.problem: Lattice adds an unexplained mathematical name although the only property used is that the decoder can select only one of the finitely many preferred angles. No later calculation needs lattice structure.
findings.deletion_test: Keep the discrete-output point, because it explains short-lag artifacts; remove the unnecessary name.
findings.earlier_teaching_checked: Search of actual current chapters finds lattice only here; preceding sentence specifies largest-rate neuron and earlier foundations give the finite ring neuron order.
findings.replacement: Its output can only be one of the neurons' preferred angles
findings.qualification_preserved: Only the lattice clause changes; keep the following shape-change clause and short-lag interpretation.

findings.problem: Ensemble is an unnecessary new specialist noun in a practical progression. The sentence only needs several repeated model runs, and no ensemble-level mathematical distinction is used afterward.
findings.deletion_test: Keep the intermediate scale between one check and the published setting; state the runs directly.
findings.earlier_teaching_checked: The preceding Monte Carlo paragraph explicitly teaches repeating calculations and independent repeats; ensemble has no earlier definition in current chapters.
findings.qualification_preserved: Does not add a new independence promise; retains progression from one deterministic/map check to repeated runs and then the published set.

truth_status: Earlier truth findings resolved in recheck-routes-truth2.json; no new truth concern raised here.
limits: This is a separate Stage2 call, not a Stage3 flow/whole-book judgment.
No manuscript edits, image pixel check, author-code execution, rebuild or release acceptance.
Source verification limits from Stage1 remain unchanged.
